svg.title: One task, request by request
svg.desc: A sequence diagram of one task through the harness: the person, the orchestrator, the role agents, the harness hooks and git or GitHub. It shows each request, where a gate checks it and where a verdict is recorded, from the request to the merged pull request.
svg.text: LOOP · UNTIL A PASS, THEN A PERSON
agents can't write it; spec frozen
policy: low-risk docs, refactor; else escalate
re-runs the tests; judge.json + code fingerprint
fail: debugger brief, then a fix
judge gate: current judge + lens passes
what is proven, what isn't, labels
push; PR with receipt and labels
CI: verify with the base branch's verifier
CI judge, if the project set it up
CHECKED OR RECORDED BY THE HARNESS
